description:
Liv Harper avoids men after betrayal and infidelity. Until Nao appears — calm, gentle, seemingly incapable of causing harm. Yet Liv has no idea who he really is.

Ashley Arden lives with the feeling that she is seen only for her appearance. She begins therapy with Ren Shirogane, a psychologist known for iron self-discipline; their interaction exposes an inner conflict between professional duty and human vulnerability.

Vesper Hope has spent years convincing herself that a person’s worth can be measured by a number on the scale. She agrees to take part in an artistic project by Simon Blackwell — a photographer whose past wounds are unexpectedly reopened by her presence. Vesper unintentionally sharpens the unresolved conflict between Simon and Kain Everton, where one has learned to remain silent and the other never intended to forget.

Saving the drowning is the work of the drowning themselves. Three stories about people trying to survive on their own, when no help is coming.
